description: List every viaSocket Developer Hub plugin (app) the user's organization owns. Send filter=getAllPlugins and identifier equal to the orgId in the path. Start here to find a pluginId (rowid).

fields.description: Optional comma-separated list of columns to return, e.g. rowid,name,status,iconurl

filter.description: Required. Must be getAllPlugins. e.g. getAllPlugins

identifier.description: Required. Your orgId (same as the path)

name: list_plugins
